text:
```artifact
S = {
  Start,
  CheckSameAccount,
  CheckSufficientFunds,
  Debit,
  Credit,
  Commit,
  RejectSameAccount,
  RejectInsufficientFunds,
  End
}

I = { Start }

T = {
  Start --[initiateTransfer(source, target, amount)]--> CheckSameAccount,

  CheckSameAccount --[guard: source == target]--> RejectSameAccount
    [action: raise InvalidTransfer],

  CheckSameAccount --[guard: source != target]--> CheckSufficientFunds,

  CheckSufficientFunds --[guard: source.balance >= amount]--> Debit,

  CheckSufficientFunds --[guard: source.balance < amount]--> RejectInsufficientFunds
    [action: raise InsufficientFunds],

  Debit --[action: source.balance := source.balance - amount]--> Credit,

  Credit --[action: target.balance := target.balance + amount]--> Commit,

  Commit --> End,

  RejectSameAccount --> End,

  RejectInsufficientFunds --> End
}

Invariant:
  For any reachable state S:
    if S ∈ {RejectSameAccount, RejectInsufficientFunds} then
      source.balance and target.balance are unchanged from the values at Start.
```
